[RARC.5.7.9] Every dispatcher action reaches the stream before it leaves
the engine, as an `action_call`, `action_publish`, `action_cache_set`,
`action_cache_delete` or `action_log` event (`proto/stream_event_kind.proto`).
A `cached()` read reaches neither the stream nor a callback: the cache is
engine state ([LSTO.4.7]) and a read is a pure internal read, re-derived on
replay from the cache writes the replayed rules make again. It is therefore no replay input
([LFST.9.2]).
